Lunch: sundubu set with rice (large free) and side dishes; dinner: Korean dishes à la carte, rice and banchan are not included at dinner (September 2026 review). Reservations accepted, online (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: 9 at the counter, 8 at tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeout; menu with photos (Tabelog). Lunch fills with office workers; arrive at opening to sit easily (July 2026 reviews). Opened 16 September 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-33-15, Apple Bldg 1F (Nishi-ku), on Naniwa-suji — 2 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 2, 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Sundubu (Korean soft-tofu stew) restaurant and Korean izakaya (17 seats) · tofu made in the shop every morning, broth of wagyu beef bones and tail, homemade tategi chili paste · eight kinds of sundubu, spice level 0 and up, over 20 toppings · lunch set: sundubu with rice (large free; or swap for ramen or glass noodles), raw egg, Korean seaweed and kimchi and namul, ¥1,000 plain, ¥1,550 horumon with clams · dinner: beef and horumon sundubu ¥1,450, Kirishima black pork sundubu ¥1,550, toppings such as natto and okra ¥100, kimchi chijimi ¥1,210, chive jeon, mozzarella jeon, sukiyaki-style bulgogi, kimbap, stone-grilled cheese bibimbap, wagyu yukhoe, soy-marinated and spicy-marinated shrimp (ganjang saeu, yangnyeom saeu), bossam, shaved ice · Korean soju, makgeolli, highballs, draft beer ¥550
places.notes: [Korean · Shinmachi, sundubu from 11 am to 11:30 pm] A clean, modern 17-seat room on Naniwa-suji, two minutes from Nishi-Ohashi Station, that opened in September 2025 as the second shop of a sundubu restaurant whose first is in Yuzato. The tofu is made in the shop every morning and the broth is wagyu bone and tail with a homemade tategi chili paste; diners call it rich and deep, with clams and a hint of sweetness under the heat. Pick one of eight sundubu (the horumon version is the favourite), a spice level from 0 up, and toppings. At lunch it comes with rice, a raw egg, Korean seaweed and kimchi and namul for about ¥1,000, and the room fills with office workers. Evenings turn into a Korean izakaya: soy- and spice-marinated shrimp that drew a 'What is this? So delicious!' from one table, wagyu yukhoe, chijimi, bulgogi, and makgeolli. The name is read Toshi, not Shun, as one diner learned. It stays open between lunch and dinner, a plus for one regular.

chef_bio.background: Sundubu restaurant that opened on 16 September 2025 (Tabelog); the second shop of a sundubu restaurant whose main branch is in Yuzato, with a third recently opened in Kutarou-cho (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Korean flavours in a relaxed, casual room for solo diners or groups; set meals at lunch, Korean dishes such as bossam and chijimi at dinner (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Sundubu with homemade tofu, wagyu-bone broth and homemade tategi.

anecdotes.text: "Homemade tofu made fresh every morning / Black-haired Wagyu beef bone tail soup / Homemade tategi miso. These three elements combined create a broth that is rich in flavor, possibly the best sundubu I've ever had!" — October 2025, horumon sundubu lunch set.
"The moment we took a bite of the kanjang saeu and yangnyeom saeu that arrived first, we all exclaimed, 'What is this? So delicious!!'" — September 2026, a group dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スンドゥブ食堂 駿、大阪市西区新町1-33-15 アップルビル 1F、西大橋駅2番出口から徒歩2分、四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日11:00〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00、テイクアウトのL.O.も23:00)、予約可 (ネット予約)、カード (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners、銀聯)・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、17席 (カウンター9、テーブル8)、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト、写真つきメニュー、オープン日2025年9月16日。店の紹介: 気軽に本場の韓国の味、選べるスンドゥブ8種、ランチは定食が中心、夜は bossam やチヂミなどの韓国料理、テイクアウトも、韓国焼酎、マッコリ、ハイボール。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年9月): 毎朝作る自家製豆腐、黒毛和牛の骨とテールのスープ、自家製の tategi、辛さは0から8段階、トッピング20種以上、ランチはご飯 (大盛り無料、ラーメンか春雨に変更可) と生卵、韓国のり、キムチとナムルつきで1000円、ホルモンとあさりで1550円、夜は牛肉とホルモンのスンドゥブ1450円、Kirishima の黒豚のスンドゥブ1550円、納豆・オクラのトッピング100円、キムチチヂミ1210円、ニラのチヂミ、モッツァレラのチヂミ、すき焼き風プルコギ、キンパ、石焼きチーズビビンバ、和牛ユッケ、ganjang saeu と yangnyeom saeu、かき氷、生ビール550円、卓上の酢で味を変える、昼は会社員でいっぱい、昼から夜まで通しで営業、スタンプカード、本店は Yuzato でここは2号店、Kutarou-cho に3号店、店名は「しゅん」ではなく「とし」と読む。

places.name: かっちゃんラーメン (Kacchan Ramen)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-made wheat noodles, soy-based tare, and gyoza and fried sides.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-bone broth with chicken oil and a hint of shellfish; chashu; egg in the fried rice.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–00:30 (last order 24:00) (Tabelog). Evening side dishes from 16:00 (October 2026 review). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog); order and pay at the ticket machine, cash only (August 2026 review). 24 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 12 August 2026 (Tabelog; operator news). Run by ALL WIN Co., Ltd., an Osaka company that also operates CoCo Ichibanya and Ramen Daisensou franchises; Kacchan Ramen is its own brand and its only shop on the operator's store list (allwin2002.com, October 2026). A diner says the site was earlier a ramen shop of the same company (October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kita-Kyuhojimachi 2-1-2 — 2 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn exit 10
places.cuisine: Showa-style chuka soba shop (24 seats), shoyu, shio and miso · clear, light chicken-bone broth with chicken oil and a hint of shellfish, house-made thin straight noodles · chuka soba ¥980, shio ramen ¥980, miso ramen, garlic ramen · flavored egg ¥120, extra chashu, extra noodles · every ramen comes with a free mini fried rice; all-you-can-eat fried rice +¥380 · gyoza with a handmade filling, kara-age, kimchi · from 16:00: fried horse mackerel, menchi katsu, thick ham cutlet, cream croquettes, croquettes, red sausages, liver and garlic stir-fry · on the table: spicy miso, garlic vinegar, fried-rice sauce, chili oil, gyoza sauce, ramen pepper
places.notes: [Ramen · Sakaisuji-Hommachi, chuka soba and free fried rice until 12:30 am] A lively 24-seat shop two minutes from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station that opened in August 2026 with one hook: every bowl comes with a free mini fried rice, and ¥380 more makes it all-you-can-eat. The operator, an Osaka company that also runs CoCo Ichibanya and Ramen Daisensou franchises, set out to make the town chuka soba of a Showa childhood: house-made noodles and a clear, light broth in shoyu, shio or miso. Diners describe chicken-bone stock with chicken oil, a hint of shellfish and a slightly sweet soy, with thin straight noodles; one called it Tokyo-style with an Osaka twist. The fried rice has drawn YouTubers: refills come out in about two minutes, and diners report going back four or five times, but one late-night diner found it bland and the garlic ramen not hot. After 4 pm a list of Showa diner sides appears, from horse-mackerel fry to red sausages. Cash only at the ticket machine; open daily until 12:30 am.

chef_bio.background: Chuka soba shop that opened on 12 August 2026 (Tabelog; operator news). Operated by ALL WIN Co., Ltd., an Osaka company whose businesses include its own restaurant brands, CoCo Ichibanya and ramen franchises, and fitness studios; Kacchan Ramen is listed as its only shop of that name (allwin2002.com, October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: The classic over the trend: a Showa town chuka soba built on shoyu, shio and miso, remade for today with house-made noodles focused on wheat flavour and a clear, light broth; gyoza made from the filling up; fast, tasty and filling (operator news, 12 August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chuka soba with free fried rice.

anecdotes.text: "The clear broth had a slightly brown tint, with a delightful sweetness and umami from shellfish, balanced with a decent saltiness. The generous amount of chicken fat added richness, making it delicious!" — October 2026, chuka soba ¥980.
"Thanks to a free coupon I received from my last visit and the all-you-can-eat fried rice, I only paid an incredible JPY 380! I went back for fried rice 5 times!" — August 2026, second visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かっちゃんラーメン、大阪市中央区北久宝寺町2-1-2、堺筋本町駅10番出口から徒歩2分、毎日11:00〜24:30 (L.O. 24:00)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、24席、禁煙、オープン日2026年8月12日。運営会社 (株式会社ALL WIN) のお知らせ: 「堺筋本町　かっちゃんラーメン」2026年8月12日グランドオープン、時代に逆らい流行より王道を選んだ、醤油・塩・味噌を柱にした中華そばの店、子どものころの町の中華そば屋、昭和の中華そば、自家製麺は小麦の風味と喉ごしにこだわり、スープは澄んだあっさり仕立て、餃子は餡から手作り、焼きめしはこだわりの卵で、はやい・うまい・腹いっぱい。店舗一覧にはほかにCoCo壱番屋、ラーメン大戦争など。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 中華そば980円、塩ラーメン980円、味玉120円、みそラーメン、にんにくラーメン、ラーメンには小さいチャーハンが無料、380円でチャーハン食べ放題、おかわりは2分ほど、4〜5杯食べた人も、鶏ガラと鶏油、ほのかに貝、九州の甘めの醤油、細いストレート麺、チャーシューは薄くて小さいがやわらかいという声と、脂のある厚みという声、16時からの夜のおかず (アジフライ、メンチカツ、厚切りハムカツ、クリームコロッケ、コロッケ、赤いソーセージ、レバーとにんにくを炒めたもの)、唐揚げ、単品キムチ、にんにくの効いた餃子、券売機で現金のみ、卓上に辛味噌・にんにく酢・チャーハンのたれ・ラー油・餃子のたれ・ラーメンこしょう、YouTuberが撮影に、チャーハンは味が薄くにんにくラーメンは熱くなかったという厳しい声も、以前も同じ会社のラーメン店だったという声。

places.name: 大衆食堂スタンド そのだ (Taishu Shokudo Stand Sonoda)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; much of the menu is fried in batter or crumbs (menchi katsu, kara-age, yurinchi, croquettes) or wheat noodles, and the chashu egg and meat tofu are soy-seasoned.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-centred diner menu (chashu, menchi katsu, meat tofu, fried chicken); the Chinese soba broth is seafood-based.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); hours may change (Tabelog). Set meals at lunch with free rice, miso soup and pickles refills, and the full menu all day, so drinking starts at 11:00 (August and October 2026 reviews). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, except 11:00–14:00 non-smoking (Tabelog). Self-service water (August 2026 review). Despite "Stand" in the name, there are chairs (October 2026 review). Tabelog Izakaya 100 in 2021. Opened 11 May 2016 (Tabelog). The original Sonoda: the brand has since opened in Tokyo and Fukuoka, and the main shop is this one on the Karahori shopping street (Time Out Osaka, December 2024).
places.neighborhood: Tanimachi 6-3-7, at the end of the Karahori shopping street — 4 min from Tanimachi 6-chome Stn
places.cuisine: Showa-retro public diner and day-drinking izakaya · lunch set meals about ¥1,000 with free rice refills: chashu egg, mapo tofu (Sichuan-hot), yurinchi, yakisoba · signature chashu egg (tender chashu under a fried egg, with cabbage and mayonnaise) ¥726, Kagoshima premium chashu egg · menchi katsu with aurora sauce ¥550 · meat tofu ¥748 · anchovy and boiled-egg potato salad ¥528 · beef skirt tataki ¥759 · chicken nanban, kara-age, croquettes, spicy fries with an aurora-sauce dip, edamame peperoncino · celery pickled in nam pla, celery and bean-sprout namul, garland chrysanthemum namul, menma · Chinese soba ¥990 (seafood soy broth, flat noodles, chashu and clams), usually the finish · Kohaku Ebisu draft ¥528, Baisu sour, sudachi sour, Pattaya sour, lemon sour ¥528, highball ¥528, sake and wine
places.notes: [Izakaya · Tanimachi 6-chome, the original Sonoda: chashu egg and drinks from 11 am] A lively Showa-retro diner at the end of the Karahori shopping street that opened in 2016, made Tabelog's Izakaya 100 in 2021 and has since spawned branches in Tokyo and Fukuoka. By day office workers pack in for ¥1,000 set meals with free rice refills; at any hour others settle in with a Kohaku Ebisu or a Baisu sour. The dish everyone orders is the chashu egg, tender chashu under a fried egg; then the menchi katsu under aurora sauce, meat tofu, nam-pla-pickled celery and chicken nanban. Many finish with the Chinese soba, a seafood-based shoyu with flat noodles, chashu and clams, which one diner called a bowl you wouldn't expect from a tavern. One diner thinks the site was once a butcher's. Cash only, no bookings, and smoking is allowed after 2 pm. A returning diner found the service slipping on a quiet September 2026 afternoon.

chef_bio.background: Public diner and izakaya that opened on 11 May 2016 (Tabelog); Tabelog Izakaya 100 in 2021 (Tabelog). The main shop of the Sonoda brand, which has expanded to Tokyo and Fukuoka (Time Out Osaka, December 2024). A diner understands it to be a sister shop of Taifuu Hanten nearby, which also serves the chashu egg (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Chashu egg; menchi katsu; meat tofu; Chinese soba.

anecdotes.text: "The Chinese Soba had a rich broth with a robust flavor, making it quite delicious. The noodles had a nice chewy texture and elasticity. It was a bowl of high quality that you wouldn't expect from a popular tavern." — October 2026, Chinese soba ¥990.

"This time, I ordered the Chinese-style ramen for the first time, and the light broth was easy to drink and delicious. The signature chashu egg was still impressively generous in portion." — October 2026, a return visit.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-based broth.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu beef tendon and a seafood-based broth (beef-bone broth for the WHITE).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); closed Sunday and public holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch only: the ramen is served by day inside the yakiniku and horumon restaurant 和ちゃん (Instagram @yakiniku.kazuchan), which is a yakiniku restaurant at night (2025 reviews; Instagram). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Full around 12:30 on a September 2025 visit. Opened 9 September 2024 (Tabelog; Instagram profile). The newest Tabelog review is from September 2025, so check Instagram @sakichan.ramen before going.
places.neighborhood: Minamihonmachi 1-5-1, 1F — 193 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn
places.cuisine: Lunchtime wagyu beef-tendon chuka soba in a yakiniku restaurant · three bowls: BLACK (soy-based), WHITE (beef-bone broth), RED (spicy, with Korean chili) · beef tendon BLACK ¥780 · Mashi Mashi BLACK (extra tendon and green onion) ¥1,100 · toppings: A5 wagyu beef tendon, menma, green onion, onion, egg yolk · beef tendon bokkake rice ¥350 · rice set with kimchi · limited chilled lemon ramen and chilled mazesoba (August 2025)
places.notes: [Ramen · Minamihonmachi, a yakiniku shop's lunchtime beef-tendon chuka soba] By night a yakiniku and horumon restaurant in the Minamihonmachi office district; at lunch, since September 2024, a ramen counter that puts the yakiniku kitchen's A5 wagyu beef tendon on chuka soba. There are three bowls: the dark, soy-based BLACK, the beef-bone WHITE and the chili-red RED. One diner expected beef and found seafood first: the BLACK is a sweet, seafood-scented shoyu that looks heavier than it tastes, with slow-simmered tendon, chopped onion and green onion, and an egg yolk to stir in. The RED is sweet and spicy with plenty of Korean chili. Noodles are medium and chewy. The plain BLACK was ¥780 in 2025; the Mashi Mashi with extra tendon and green onion ¥1,100, and a ¥350 bowl of tendon bokkake rice finishes the job. The newest review is from September 2025, so check the shop's Instagram first.

chef_bio.background: Lunch-only ramen that opened on 9 September 2024 (Tabelog) inside the yakiniku and horumon restaurant 和ちゃん, which serves yakiniku at night (Instagram @yakiniku.kazuchan; 2025 reviews). A diner credits the bowls to the yakiniku chef (May 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Ramen built on the same wagyu the yakiniku uses; the sign promises the ultimate ramen made with Japanese wagyu beef tendon (April 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu beef-tendon chuka soba, BLACK, WHITE and RED.

anecdotes.text: "The broth was a deep-colored soy sauce, with a sweet seafood aroma that balanced the flavors. I initially imagined it would be beef-based, but the seafood flavor was more prominent." — September 2025, beef tendon BLACK ¥780.
"The beef tendon was generously sized, thoroughly simmered, and surprisingly tender. The sweetness of the fat melded with the umami of the meat." — April 2025, beef tendon chuka soba RED.

Opened 1 March 2007 (Tabelog; the shop site says 2007).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-22-19 — about 4 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn, between Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi; near the Orix Theater
places.cuisine: Small cake shop and café, "additive-free sweets" (13 seats) · roll cakes, including a fruit roll made to order · apple pie · strawberry tart · caramel cheesecake · cream puffs and pies filled with custard after ordering · pudding and lemon pudding · soufflé · light lunches: gratin lunch with salad, focaccia and orange ¥950 (May 2026); buckwheat-flour pizza ¥890 (June 2024) · baked goods to take away: cheese marble brownie, large black-soybean kinako macaron, mini macarons without colouring or preservatives, caramel pound cake, dacquoise roll, cookies, homemade orange jam and chocolate-dipped orange peel · tea and blended coffee
places.notes: [Cake shop and café · Shinmachi, a one-person patisserie since 2007] A small cake shop between Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi that has outlasted the area's fast-changing cafés since 2007, with a motto of sweets that are gentle on body and mind and an online store branded "additive-free sweets". The owner bakes, runs the café and cooks lunch alone, so things take a while: the fruit roll cake is rolled to order and the cream puffs and pies are filled after you ask. Diners single out the apple pie (one was told to try it both warmed and as it is), a moist roll with fresh chocolate cream, a mousse-like lemon pudding and a sweet caramel cheesecake. Light lunches change: a piping-hot bacon-and-mushroom gratin set (¥950, May 2026), and earlier a buckwheat-flour pizza. Prices are low; bring cash.

roles: Owner (business operator named on the shop's online-store legal notice)
chef_bio.background: The legal notice of the shop's online store names 湯川律子 as the business operator, at the shop's address. Reviews describe a woman owner who runs the shop alone: a June 2024 diner saw the female owner working single-handed, and a May 2026 diner says the pastry chef "makes cakes for sale and also runs the café and lunch service". A November 2023 diner saw a lone staff member serving a full room. Opened 1 March 2007 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sweets gentle on body and mind, made without additives (shop site: 心と体に優しいお菓子作りをモットーに; online store name 無添加スイーツ).
chef_bio.specialty: Roll cakes; apple pie; black-soybean kinako macarons; cheese marble brownies.

anecdotes.text: "Wow—served piping hot, and there was even bread inside! Such a generous portion! The creamy homemade sauce was wonderfully gentle..." — May 2026, gratin lunch ¥950.
"Despite the frequent turnover of cafes in this area, its long-standing presence indicates its popularity." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パティスリー らねっと、大阪市西区新町1-22-19、西大橋駅から徒歩4分、月〜土・祝10:30〜18:00 (売り切れ次第終了)、日曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、13席、喫煙所あり、テイクアウト可、オープン日2007年3月1日。店のサイト (無添加スイーツ パティスリーらねっと): 大阪市西区新町のカフェ兼ケーキ屋、2007年オープン、心と体に優しいお菓子作りがモットー。オンラインストアに黒豆きな粉マカロン (農家直送の卵白、北海道産バタークリーム)、チーズマーブルブラウニー (オーストラリア産クリームチーズ、ベルギー産チョコレート)、ダクワーズロール、キャラメルパウンドケーキ、マカロン4種 (着色料・保存料無添加)、焼き菓子詰め合わせ、自家製オレンジジャム。特定商取引法に基づく表記の事業者の名称: 湯川律子。口コミ(2023年11月〜2026年9月): 女性のオーナーがひとりでケーキ、カフェ、ランチ、注文を受けてから仕上げるフルーツロール、シュークリームとパイもカスタードは注文後、アップルパイ、生チョコクリームのロールケーキ、レモンのミルクプリン、キャラメルチーズケーキ、いちごのタルト、スフレ、グラタンのランチ950円 (2026年5月)、そば粉のピザ890円 (2024年6月)、値段は手ごろ、現金のみ、Orix Theater の帰りに。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; one person runs everything, so allow time (2026).

places.name: 伊勢田 (ISEDA)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the focus is wheat-battered kushikatsu, and the hot pot finishes with ramen or udon.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: offal skewers, beef and pork kushikatsu, raw beef yukhoe and a beef-horumon hot pot; ask before relying on the vegetable kushikatsu.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); Wed 17:30–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog), but an April 2026 diner was told bills under ¥5,000 are cash only, plus a ¥330 table charge. 18 seats: a counter, three booths and tables (Tabelog; September 2026 review). Smoking allowed at every seat; at most two children, no strollers (Tabelog). Busy before and after shows at the nearby Orix Theater (September 2026 review). Moved from Kitahorie 2-3-3 (the old Tabelog listing is marked relocated); the listing remarks say the new shop opened in April 2021.
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-9-14, 1F — 3 min from Nishi-Ohashi or Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Showa-style kushikatsu and horumon izakaya (18 seats) · kushikatsu by the stick: pork ¥170, beef ¥220, shrimp ¥300, scallop ¥280, Camembert ¥230, vegetables ¥130, red pickled ginger ¥150; assortment of 10 ¥1,690 (April 2026) · grilled horumon skewers ¥200–250 · grilled liver ¥700 · beef tataki yukhoe ¥890 · dote-yaki ¥590 · konjac steak (salt or garlic) ¥580 · chicken kara-age ¥700 · ISEDA Classic Chiri-tori teppan-nabe ¥2,980, beef horumon and vegetables, spice adjustable, finished with rice, ramen or udon ¥480 · cold kimchi noodles ¥890 · gukbap, soups, kimchi · sets: kushikatsu 6 ¥1,800, horumon skewers 6 ¥1,900, special course ¥7,000 (Tabelog menu, updated April 2026)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu and horumon · Shinmachi, a smoky Showa-style counter by the Orix Theater] A lively kushikatsu izakaya that moved from Kitahorie to a ground-floor spot near the Orix Theater, billing itself as a trip back to the good old Showa era. The batter is light and crisp; diners also go for the grilled offal skewers, a grilled liver with sesame oil and salt, a sweet-spicy Chiri-tori hot pot of beef horumon and vegetables in a square iron pan, and the specialty dote-yaki. Finish with ramen in the pot, cold kimchi noodles, or a cheese risotto. The sauce once came in a shared no-double-dipping pot (2025); by April 2026 it was poured over the plate. A May 2025 group found the owner very pleasant, and later diners felt it was a regulars' place that still made a newcomer feel warmly welcome. Every seat allows smoking, and a 2025 diner found the ventilation weak.

chef_bio.background: Kushikatsu and horumon izakaya, formerly on Naniwa-suji in Kitahorie (old Tabelog listing marked relocated, Kitahorie 2-3-3); the current shop opened in April 2021 per the Tabelog remarks. A May 2025 group was "warmly welcomed by a very pleasant owner".
chef_bio.philosophy: A Showa-era atmosphere (Tabelog tagline, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Kushikatsu; horumon skewers; Chiri-tori teppan-nabe; dote-yaki.

anecdotes.text: "I previously visited ISEDA when it was located along Naniwa-suji in Kitahorie. This is my first time at the new location in Shinmachi." — April 2026, assorted kushikatsu, 10 pieces, ¥1,690.
"The grilled liver skewers were so delicious that I wanted to order more! They had no unpleasant odor and were easy to eat with sesame oil and salt." — August 2025.

places.name: くるみ製菓店 (Kurumi Seikaten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the shop is built around madeleines, financiers, shell cakes and sablés, which are normally wheat-flour baking. Soft serve is the only other item; ask about its toppings and the shared kitchen.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fermented butter, almonds and honey in the baking, milk soft serve and egg pudding.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–19:00, open all year (Tabelog; shop site). The 3 counter seats inside are by reservation only, and reservations are hard to get; a bench outside when the weather is fine (Tabelog; September–October 2026 reviews). Cards, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). A long line wrapped around the street on one September 2026 visit. A freshly baked madeleine or financier is given free with a purchase (September–October 2026 reviews). Opened 18 July 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-16-5, 1F — 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn (Exit 2), near the Orix Theater
places.cuisine: Baked-goods shop for madeleines and shell cakes, with soft serve (3 reserved seats) · 極上マドレーヌ (top-grade madeleines, a signature item) in many flavours: fermented butter, French butter, Takachiho butter, carrot with cinnamon, chocolate, walnut, Gorgonzola · shell cakes · financiers · sablé made with Calpis fermented butter ¥350 (October 2026) · light milk soft serve with seasonal sauce (peach in July 2026; fig or lemon in September 2026) · pudding with soft serve (to the end of September 2026) · gift boxes: madeleines 6 ¥2,100, shell cakes 10 ¥3,990 (online store)
places.notes: [Baked sweets · Shinmachi, a madeleine shop with three hard-to-book seats] A tiny shop near the Orix Theater where the smell of fermented butter fills the room and the oven sits in full view. Almost everything is to take away — boxes of madeleines in a dozen flavours (fermented butter, French or Takachiho butter, carrot, chocolate, walnut, Gorgonzola) and the shop's shell cakes — and every purchase comes with one still warm from the oven. The three seats inside are reserved for a light, milky soft serve with a seasonal sauce, or a firm pudding on top of it. Two diners link it with Chihiro Kashiten a few streets away: a September 2026 diner calls it a sister shop, and an October 2026 diner says the logo looks familiar and the shop is run by the son of a former influencer who had sold shares in that shop. A line may wrap the block.

chef_bio.background: Baked-goods shop that opened on 18 July 2025 (Tabelog); the online store's legal notice names the company 株式会社ミクリエーション and, as business operator, 染川優輝 (no reading given). The shop site lists this one shop. Its relationship to ちひろ菓子店 (Chihiro Kashiten, skipped in b200 as a chain) is unclear: a September 2026 review calls it "a sister shop of Chihiro", while an October 2026 review says it is run by the son of a former influencer who had sold shares in the shop it resembles. Chihiro's own online store names a different company (株式会社DADACA).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sweets made with good fermented butter, almonds and honey and as few additives as possible; staff and the oven visible from the counter; aims to be "the world's most loved baked-goods shop" (shop site: 世界一愛される焼き菓子店).

anecdotes.text: "As a specialty madeleine shop, they offer a wide variety. The aroma of fermented butter fills the store, which is impressive." — July 2026.
"This place is run by the son of a former influencer who previously sold the shop's shares." — October 2026, sablé with Calpis fermented butter ¥350.
"I was impressed by Google, which has 1,300 reviews and a rating of 4.9, so I decided to visit." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: くるみ製菓店、大阪市西区新町1-16-5 1F、四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日10:00〜19:00、イートインは予約のみ (カウンター3席)、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay可、電子マネー不可、禁煙、持ち込み可、テイクアウト可、オープン日2025年7月18日。店のサイト: 上質な発酵バター・アーモンド・はちみつを贅沢に使い、添加物を極力使わない「安心・安全」なお菓子、看板商品は「シェルケーキ」と「極上マドレーヌ」、スタッフの作業風景やオーブンが見える内装、「世界一愛される焼き菓子店」をめざす、年中無休、極上マドレーヌBOX (6個) 2100円、シェルケーキBOX (10個) 3990円。特定商取引法に基づく表記: 株式会社ミクリエーション、事業者の名称 染川優輝、新町1-16-5 橋口ビル1F。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): マドレーヌの専門店、発酵バターの香り、焼きたてを1個サービス、発酵バター、フランス産バター、Takachiho のバター、にんじん、チョコ、くるみ、ゴルゴンゾーラ、Calpis の発酵バターのサブレ350円、季節のソースのソフトクリーム (桃、いちじく、レモン)、固めのプリンとソフトクリーム、予約が取りにくい、外にベンチ、行列、ちひろの姉妹店という声と、元インフルエンサーの息子が営むという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; book ahead for the 3 seats (2026).

places.name: ハワイアン食堂 HALE (Hawaiian Shokudo HALE)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the poke bowls can sit on rice or salad, but the house sauce is soy-based (soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic oil) and the menu has fried calamari, salmon and cheese, so ask about the sauces and the fryer.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A poke bowl can be built on a salad base with vegetable sides (avocado, edamame, tomato, seaweed), but every main reported is fish or meat and the salads come with miso soup; ask whether a plant-based main and sauce are possible.
places.hours_raw: Weekdays 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); Saturday and holidays 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:30); closed Sunday (shop site). Tabelog lists Mon–Fri 11:00–18:30 and Sat 11:00–15:30. No reservations (Tabelog); a March 2026 diner found it full at weekday lunch. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transit IC cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay; no service charge (Tabelog). 20 seats per Tabelog (listed as 13 inside and 10 on the terrace); non-smoking; dogs allowed on the terrace; children and strollers welcome; English menu (Tabelog). Takeout, delivery (Uber Eats) and smartphone pre-order (shop site). Opened 2 September 2019 (Tabelog). Run by Hawaiisukiyane Co., which also runs the 3POKE OSAKA, SUNNY ISLAND SURF and Hawaiian 8 Market shops (company site).
places.neighborhood: Hakuromachi 1-8-12 — 5 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi and Nagahoribashi Stns
places.cuisine: Hawaiian diner and café built around custom poke bowls (20 seats incl. terrace) · tick an order sheet: one base (multigrain rice, salad greens, or half and half), two mains, four sides, one sauce, one topping; extras cost more · e.g. tuna and salmon, salmon and roast beef; avocado, tomato, tobiko, edamame, egg yolk; house sauce of soy sauce, sesame oil and garlic oil · Original poke bowl ¥1,150, Classic poke bowl ¥1,100, loco moco ¥1,170, mochiko chicken plate ¥1,080, garlic shrimp plate ¥1,400, açaí bowl ¥1,550, ahi poke ¥870 (shop menu) · fried calamari, salmon fry, cheese fry, nachos · customizable salads with miso soup · Kona coffee ¥820, guava and pineapple juice, Kona and Budweiser bottled beer · a seasonal poke each month
places.notes: [Hawaiian · Hakuromachi, build-your-own poke bowls] A bright, wood-toned Hawaiian café between Sakaisuji-Hommachi and Nagahoribashi that has served custom poke bowls since 2019 and bills itself as the first in Osaka to do so. You tick an order sheet: a base of multigrain rice, salad or half and half, two mains such as tuna, salmon or tender roast beef, four sides like avocado, tobiko, edamame and egg yolk, then a sauce; extras push the bill up (one diner reached ¥1,350 in April 2025 and remembers when it was under ¥1,000). Beyond poke there is loco moco, garlic shrimp tender enough to eat shells and all, crisp mochiko chicken and a fruit-heavy açaí bowl, plus a terrace where dogs are welcome. Seating is limited, so weekday lunch can fill up; no reservations.

chef_bio.background: Hawaiian diner that opened on 2 September 2019 (Tabelog), billed by the shop as Osaka's first custom poke bowl specialist (Tabelog, shop-provided). Run by Hawaiisukiyane Co. (ハワイ好きやね株式会社, founded January 2025), which also runs two 3POKE OSAKA shops, SUNNY ISLAND SURF and Hawaiian 8 Market; the company site calls HALE "ここが、はじまりのポキ。" (company site, read October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Choose-your-own poke with more than 10,000 combinations and a new seasonal poke each month (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Custom poke bowls; garlic shrimp; mochiko chicken; açaí bowl.

anecdotes.text: "The garlic shrimp was so tender that you could eat the shells, and the garlic flavor was strong, making it a great accompaniment to rice." — March 2026, Original Poke Bowl, Garlic Shrimp Plate, Mochiko Chicken and fries.
"The Poké Bowl with additional ingredients costs JPY 1350. It used to be under JPY 1000 not long ago." — April 2025.

places.name: 廣井堂 (Hiroi Do)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; many sweets are rice-based (daifuku, mochi, dango), but fu manju is made with wheat gluten, the baked sweets, pies and dorayaki are wheat-based, and the chestnut steamed yokan recipe is not stated. Ask about each sweet.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Much of the range is bean paste, rice and agar, but some sweets use egg-yolk bean paste, condensed milk, cream cheese, honey or butter and cream; ask about each sweet.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 9:00–18:00; closed Sunday, Monday and holidays, plus some irregular days; hours can shift on event days (Tabelog; shop site). Mainly takeout with 2 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Reservations taken by phone even for a single sweet; fresh sweets (namagashi) are sold by reservation (Tabelog; shop catalog). Payment: Tabelog lists QR only, no cards; the shop site lists cash, PayPay, Osaka premium vouchers and VISA, Mastercard, JCB, AMEX. Chestnut steamed yokan (栗むし羊羹) is seasonal: in 2026 from 21 September to late December, handed over from about 11:00, reservation only, no same-day sales, chilled shipping available (shop site). Founded in Meiji 10 (1877) (shop site).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-17-8, 1F (same building as milia burger) — 258 m from Nishi-Ohashi Stn; about 15 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Wagashi (Japanese sweets) shop founded 1877, mostly takeout (2 seats) · signature: chestnut steamed yokan of hand-peeled, house-candied domestic chestnuts in Hokkaido azuki koshian, autumn only — half ¥3,000, whole ¥5,900 (2026) · monaka with filling and shell made fresh: 夕霧もなか (Yūgiri monaka, tsubuan) ¥200, bear-shaped honey cream cheese monaka ¥300 · fresh sweets from ¥220 in season: daifuku, sakura mochi, kashiwa mochi, tsukimi dango wrapped Osaka-style around bean paste, pumpkin steamed manju, yuzu manju · summer chilled sweets: 笑わず餅 (Warawazu mochi), fu manju, matcha azuki, fruit kanten with watermelon and melon, mizu manju · baked sweets, chestnut manju, wakaayu, seasonal pies, senbei · dorayaki with fresh cream, butter and a choice of smooth or chunky bean paste (June 2026 review) · sekihan on the 1st and 15th
places.notes: [Wagashi · Shinmachi, a 150-year-old sweets shop run by a couple] A small Japanese-sweets shop founded in 1877 in Shinmachi, a former geisha district; the shop's sign survived the wartime fires and the shop was revived after the war. Today a married couple makes and sells everything, which is why the famous autumn chestnut steamed yokan (hand-peeled chestnuts, Hokkaido bean paste, ¥3,000 for a half) is reservation-only and gone by late December. Year-round there is Yūgiri monaka with the shell kept crisp until you buy it and a bear-shaped honey cream cheese monaka; in summer Warawazu mochi (somewhere between water yokan and mochi), bouncy mizu manju, fu manju and a fruit kanten where the watermelon is still crunchy; in September Osaka-style moon-viewing dango. One diner calls the cream-and-butter dorayaki the best ever. In August 2026 a diner waited behind a couple of customers. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 小澤康雄・小澤ゆう子
roles: Owners (a married couple), who make and sell the sweets
chef_bio.background: The shop was founded in Meiji 10 (1877) in Shinmachi, once a hanamachi; the signboard escaped the wartime fires and, "like a baton passed to the third generation", let 御菓子司 廣井堂 be revived after the war. It is now run by the married couple 小澤康雄 and 小澤ゆう子, and the couple make and sell everything (shop site, read October 2026: "小澤康雄・小澤ゆう子 夫婦にて"; the chestnut yokan page says the two make and sell everything, so mass production is hard).
chef_bio.philosophy: A small shop aiming for taste and service that please each customer; a writer once described it as "変わりゆく町の変わらない味" (the unchanging taste of a changing town) (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Chestnut steamed yokan; Yūgiri monaka; honey cream cheese monaka; Warawazu mochi.

anecdotes.text: "The firm texture of the monaka shell, which isn't soggy, pairs beautifully with the refined sweetness of the filling… The owner's service was exceptional." — August 2025, Yūgiri Monaka to take away.
"The watermelon is crunchy, and the other fruits don't feel mushy at all; you can really tell they were just peeled!" — September 2025, fruit kanten.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 御菓子屋 廣井堂、明治十年創業、かつて花街だった新町、店の上の看板が戦火を逃れ、戦後「御菓子司 廣井堂」を再生、小澤康雄・小澤ゆう子 夫婦、ふたりで製造販売、「変わりゆく町の変わらない味」、大阪府大阪市西区新町1丁目17-8 ハイネス新町公園1F、火曜日〜土曜日9時〜18時。栗むし羊羹: 国産大栗を自家製で皮むきから炊いて蜜漬け、北海道産小豆こし餡、2026年は9月21日から12月後半まで、11時ごろから渡す、予約は電話か店頭、当日販売なし、冷蔵4日、半本3000円 (箱入り3250円)、一本5900円 (箱入り6200円)、現金・PayPay・プレミアム商品券・カード可、クール便で発送。カタログ: 生菓子220円から (一つから予約で)、大福餅、花びら餅、うぐいす餅、いちご大福、さくら餅、草もち、かしわ餅、ちまき、月見だんご、かぼちゃのむしまんじゅう、柚子まんじゅう、焼き菓子 (季の彩菓、梅の香、菊からくさ、栗まんじゅう、いも黄金、若鮎)、パイ、五色煎餅、格子煎餅、冷菓 (笑わず餅、麩まんじゅう、抹茶小豆、ふるーつ寒天、水まんじゅう)、棹菓子 (しんまち、栗羊羹、柿羊羹、柚子羊羹)、夕霧もなか200円、はちみつクリームチーズもなか300円、赤飯は毎月1日・15日、6月16日の和菓子の日に感謝祭。食べログ: 火〜土9:00〜18:00、日曜・月曜・祝日休み、不定休あり、一つから予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、2席、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ(2025年8月〜2026年10月): 皮がしけない夕霧もなか、店主の接客、スイカがシャキッとしたフルーツ寒天、笑わず餅、抹茶小豆、水まんじゅう、生クリームとバターの dorayaki、クマの形のはちみつクリームチーズもなか、麩まんじゅう、若鮎、大阪式の月見だんご、数人待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeout counter; reserve the chestnut yokan and fresh sweets by phone (2026).

places.notes: [Burgers · Shinmachi, choose every layer] A calm, café-like burger shop in the stylish Shinmachi area that opened in 2016 billing itself as Japan's first custom-burger specialist. Pick a brown, white or whole-wheat bun (or lettuce instead), a beef patty, pork rib or chicken leg, one of ten house-made sauces and three vegetables, or order a set burger like the Tex-Mex with avocado and jalapeños or the ABC. Diners single out the patty: coarse-ground with steak-like chunks, cooked rare and juicy enough to soak the bun. The owner explained the menu to one first-time diner in May 2026. One diner found it pricey for the size. Sofas and a terrace; open until 9 pm Thursday to Saturday, and fine for just a drink.

chef_bio.background: Custom-burger shop that opened on 16 June 2016, billed by the shop as Japan's first custom burger specialty shop (Tabelog, shop-provided). Diners mention the owner explaining the menu (May and July 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Build your own burger: 1.2 million combinations per the shop site (Tabelog's shop text says 13.5 million), all sauces made in-house (shop site).

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, the owner kindly explained the menu… the original Tex-Mex Burger for JPY 1,668… The meat sauce tied everything together beautifully, with a delightful kick from the jalapeños." — May 2026.
"Inside the coarsely ground meat, there are tender chunks, providing a texture close to steak… The meat is cooked rare." — July 2026, ABC Burger ¥1,668.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the food is fruit sandwiches on bread and baked goods. Only the drinks (hand-drip coffee, tea, juices, cream soda) are free of bread.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the fruit sandwiches are made with cream cheese or flavoured cream, and the strawberry milk and cream soda carry ice cream. The Japanese apple and mikan juices are the plain options.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–16:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog, shop site). Seats can be reserved through Tabelog; items can then be reserved by Instagram message; no same-day reservations; at busy times seating is limited to one hour (Tabelog). Order and pay at the entrance, then sit (April–July 2026 reviews). Tabelog says cashless payment only (cards, IC cards, PayPay); an August 2026 review says cash or PayPay only — check. 14 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 22 February 2024 (Tabelog). Up the stairs at the side of the building; the entrance is shared with Pan to Espresso to and is easy to miss (June–July 2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Fruit kissa (14 seats) · fruit sandwiches with seasonal fruit, from ¥1,400 (official menu): fig, orange and kiwi with cream cheese ¥1,400 (May and August 2026), white peach with Earl Grey cream ¥1,600 (July 2026), American cherry with chocolate cream (June 2026) · strawberry milk with strawberry pieces, vanilla ice cream and fresh strawberries ¥700 (April 2026) · キャンドルムー (Candle mou) ¥700, baked goods from ¥350 (official menu) · hand-drip coffee, tea, cream soda, Japanese apple and mikan juice (official menu) · an acai bowl was sold out on a June 2026 visit · shelves of manga to read
places.notes: [Kissa · Minamisenba, fruit sandwiches upstairs in a former bank] A fruit kissa on the second floor of the Sakaisuji Club, a building that went up as a bank in 1931 (April 2026 review); Pan to Espresso to bakes on the ground floor, and the same company runs both. The entrance and staircase are grand, the room is retro and calm, with many clocks, tables stamped with fruit patterns and a wall of manga to read. The draw is the thick-cut fruit sandwich: figs, orange and kiwi with cream cheese, white peach with Earl Grey cream, American cherries with chocolate cream — the fruit changes with the season. A strawberry milk topped with ice cream and fresh strawberries is the other favourite. Diners may also bring up bread bought downstairs and re-toast it here, so seats fill fast: reserve, or come early. One July 2026 diner found the peach disappointing and smelled frying from the kitchen below.

chef_bio.background: Run directly by 株式会社パンとエスプレッソと (Pan to Espresso to Co.), listed under its "other shops" on the company site; the company's Pan to Espresso to bakery café occupies the 1F of the same building (shop site). Opened 22 February 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fruit sandwiches made with seasonal fruit (June 2026 review; official menu "from ¥1,400").

anecdotes.text: "The building, constructed in 1931 as a bank, exudes a sense of grandeur. The first floor houses 'Pan to Espresso to,' while this café is on the second floor." — April 2026, strawberry milk ¥700.

"Some customers order from 'Futsuni Fruits,' while others bring in bread purchased from the first floor's 'Bread and Espresso' to enjoy in the 'Futsuni Fruits' dining area, making the seating fill up quite quickly." — June 2026, weekday 11:30 reservation.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬゛喫茶 フツウニフルウツ、大阪市中央区南船場1-15-12 堺筋倶楽部 2F、大阪メトロ堺筋本町駅・長堀橋駅から徒歩6分、毎日11:00〜16:00、不定休、予約可 (席の予約のあとインスタのメッセージで品物も予約、当日予約不可)、混雑時は1時間制、キャッシュレスのみ、14席、禁煙、オープン日2024年2月22日。店のサイト (株式会社パンとエスプレッソと): その他 (直営) に旬゛喫茶フツウニフルウツ、堺筋倶楽部2F、11:00〜16:00、不定休。メニュー: フルーツサンド1400円〜、キャンドルムー700円、焼き菓子350円〜、ハンドドリップコーヒー700円、紅茶600円、クリームソーダ850円〜、国産みかんジュース600円、国産りんごジュース600円、マンガも自由に。口コミ(2026年4月〜8月): 1931年に銀行として建った建物、1階はパンとエスプレッソと、入口で注文と支払い、マンガの棚、たくさんの時計、季節のフルーツサンド (いちじく・オレンジ・キウイとクリームチーズ1400円、白桃とアールグレイのクリーム1600円、アメリカンチェリーとチョコのクリーム)、Strawberry Milk 700円、下のパンを持ち込んでトースターで温め直せる、予約がおすすめ、現金かPayPayのみという声も、桃が残念で下の厨房の油のにおいがしたという声も。

places.name: FUKUSHIMA COFFEE&Cafe de Rope
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the food is toast, sandwiches and hot dogs. Coffee, juice, boiled eggs and bananas are the bread-free choices.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg and cheese toasts, egg sandwiches and hot dogs; café au lait and lattes are made with milk. Black coffee, mixed juice (ask) and bananas are the options.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat and public holidays 8:00–16:00; closed Sunday and Monday, and over the summer holidays and long weekends such as Golden Week; hours may change, so check (Tabelog). Coffee is paid for at the register and the staff make it (May 2025 review). Cards, IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 20 seats including counter seats with power outlets and a terrace; non-smoking, including the terrace and e-cigarettes; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; February 2026 review). Children welcome, but noisy children are not, as some guests read (Tabelog). Paid parking nearby. Opened 13 October 1988 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: In-house-roasted coffee stand and café of a coffee-roaster dealer (20 seats) · coffee ¥250 to take away, ¥300 dine-in (May 2025); hot coffee ¥350 (February 2026) · cappuccino, café latte, iced Americano, café au lait · light food only (toasts and sandwiches since about February 2024): mixed cheese toast ¥450, tamagoyaki sandwich ¥400 (February 2026); egg cheese toast ¥400, small hot dog ¥200, mixed juice ¥550 (August 2025); boiled egg ¥50, half a banana ¥50 (May 2025) · coffee beans, coffee bags and café-au-lait base for sale
places.notes: [Coffee stand · Inari near JR Namba, a roaster dealer's own café since 1988] The street smells of roasting coffee before you reach the door. This is the café of Fukushima Coffee, a company that sells, installs and repairs coffee roasters (it is the Japan agent for DIEDRICH), and gleaming machines stand on display behind the big windows; one diner was told a single FUJI ROYAL roaster costs as much as a domestic car. The coffee is roasted in-house and cheap for Namba: ¥250 to take away, ¥300 to sit, and the beans are for sale. Food is light and quick: cheese toast, a hefty tamagoyaki sandwich, a small soft hot dog, ¥50 boiled eggs and half-bananas. There is a roomy seating area at the back, counter seats with outlets for laptops, and a terrace. One diner first came before getting married and still stops by with mom after neighbourhood errands (2024–2025 reviews).

chef_bio.background: The café department, at the head office, of 株式会社福島珈琲 (Fukushima Coffee Co.), whose representative is 福島建三 (company site). The company sells new and used coffee roasters, is the Japan agent for DIEDRICH, and roasts and sells beans; the café shows roasters from several makers and does test roasts (company site). Opened 13 October 1988 (Tabelog). Once delivered lunches and served rice dishes, salads and cold noodles; by February 2024 the food was toasts and sandwiches, and the owner makes them right after the order (February 2024 review); by May 2024 the business focus had shifted to selling and maintaining roasters (May 2024 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Full support for customers' coffee businesses, from roasters to green-bean quality (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Coffee roasted in-house; cheap takeaway coffee; toasts and sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: "They use a roasting machine from the brand FUJI ROYAL, and I heard that just this one machine could buy a domestic car!" — September 2025, iced Americano to go.
"Everything is incredibly cheap! Coffee is just JPY 250 for take away, and JPY 300 for dine-in… And this is in Namba!" — May 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: FUKUSHIMA COFFEE&Cafe de Rope、大阪市浪速区稲荷1-4-18 西なんばグランドビル、JR難波駅から445m、火〜土・祝8:00〜16:00、日曜・月曜休み、夏休みやゴールデンウィークなどの連休も休み、カード・交通系IC・楽天Edy・nanaco・WAON・iD・QUICPay・QR可、20席、カウンター、テラス、禁煙 (テラスと電子タバコも)、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、子供可だが騒ぐ子供は不可、近くにコインパーキング、オープン日1988年10月13日。会社のサイト: 株式会社福島珈琲が運営するロースター&自家焙煎「カフェ・ド・ロペ」、各メーカーの焙煎機を展示しテストローストも可、テイクアウトのコーヒースタンド、コーヒー豆、コーヒーバッグ、カフェオレベースを販売、本社 (喫茶部門カフェ・ド・ロペ) は稲荷1-4-18 西なんばグランドビル1F、代表 福島建三、DIEDRICH 日本総代理店。口コミ(2024年2月〜2026年2月): 以前は昼の配達やご飯もの、サラダ、冷たい麺もあったが今はトーストとサンドイッチだけ、オーナーが注文を受けてすぐに作る、FUJI ROYAL の焙煎機、テイクアウト250円・店内300円、ゆで卵50円、バナナ半分50円、ホットドッグ200円、たまごチーズトースト400円、ミックスジュース550円、ミックスチーズトースト450円、たまご焼きサンド400円、ホットコーヒー350円、奥に広い席、カウンターにコンセント、結婚前から通う人も。

places.cuisine: Juwari soba stand by day, soba izakaya until 3–5 am (14 seats) · lunch soba with mixed rice and a small dish: mori soba large ¥1,200 (August 2024, October 2026), horumon soba ¥1,100 (November 2025), pork and green onion soba ¥1,200 (January 2025), thickened ginger chicken-and-egg soba ¥1,100 (March 2025), bukkake soba with ume, grated daikon and shirasu ¥1,380 or with grated wasabi ¥1,280 (August 2026), daily specials such as warm soba with tororo and nori (February 2026) · thick, firm, aromatic noodles; rich katsuobushi dipping sauce; thick soba-yu · seaweed, curry and matcha salts on the table · night: oden, fried loach, dashimaki, tuna sashimi, crab miso, buttered grilled eggplant, grilled fish, mozuku tempura · sake from around Japan, shochu, whisky, wine
places.notes: [Soba · Minamisenba, juwari soba by day and a late soba bar by night] A soba shop on Yokobori-suji that looks more like a stylish bar (one diner calls the interior rock and roll), with a whisky bottle on the counter even at lunch. The soba is juwari, 100% buckwheat, on the thick and firm side and strongly aromatic, so firm that one diner wondered whether it was really juwari. At lunch the soba comes with a bowl of mixed rice and a small side: horumon soba with a clear, delicate broth, a ginger-thickened chicken-and-egg soba for cold days, bukkake soba with ume and shirasu, and a large mori soba whose size made one diner laugh. Try a bite with the seaweed, curry or matcha salt before the rich katsuobushi dipping sauce, and finish with the thick soba-yu. From 19:00 it turns soba izakaya, with oden, fried loach, crab miso, mozuku tempura and sake from around Japan, open until 3 am (5 am on Friday and Saturday). An August 2026 diner recalls branches in Awaza, Fukushima and Ura-Namba that have since gone, and says the owner is now different.

chef_bio.background: Soba stand and izakaya opened on 18 November 2021 (Tabelog). An August 2026 diner remembers branches in Awaza, Fukushima and Ura-Namba that no longer exist, and says the owner is now different. Two people run lunch on a busy weekday (November 2025 review); a manager is on the floor (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: 100% buckwheat soba paired with seasonal sake; daily specials so there is something new to discover (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari mori soba; warm soba in katsuobushi broth; late-night soba with sake.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the large serving of mori soba (JPY 1200), which came with lotus root kinpira and hijiki with perilla rice… I couldn't help but laugh at how large the portion was, even more than I expected." — October 2026, weekday lunch.
"They stay open late as long as there are customers, making it a great spot for those looking to have a late-night drink in the Minamisenba area." — September 2026.

places.name: 餅匠しづく 新町店 (Mochisho Shizuku Shinmachi ten)
places.gf_detail: Some options, by the shop's own ingredient lists: the Shinmachi classics (black-bean mochi, kusa mochi, raspberry daifuku, kuro mochi, monaka, chestnut daifuku, shigure, kurumi mochi) list glutinous rice, rice flour, mochi flour, potato starch, beans, sugar, salt and fruit, and no wheat. The shop makes no gluten-free claim and says nothing about cross-contact, and the Kanro tea-room course includes savoury mochi dishes that are not listed, so ask at the counter.
places.vegan_detail: Some options, by the shop's own ingredient lists: black-bean mochi, kusa mochi, raspberry daifuku, kuro mochi, monaka, chestnut daifuku, shigure, kurumi mochi, chestnut chakin and ginkgo daifuku list only plant ingredients. Not vegan: the Mont Blanc (fresh cream, October 2026 review), fruit daifuku with cream, the Kishiwada-shop sweets made with honey, and the Kanro course (a mochi soup with crab, October 2026 review).
places.hours_raw: Daily: shop 10:30–18:00; open year-round, closures announced on the website (mochi-shizuku.jp; Tabelog). Tea room "Kanro" (甘露), opened in the renovated shop in 2026: by reservation, two seatings a day at 13:00 and 15:00, a pairing course of sweets, mochi dishes and tea ¥6,600 per person including tax, sake or a non-alcoholic drink extra; book by phone or through the online shop (prepaid online), no cancellations, walk-ins if a seat is free; junior-high age and up only; mention allergies when booking (shop notice, 15 October 2026). The old casual eat-in café is gone (October 2026 reviews); about six chairs outside (October 2026 review). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats listed; non-smoking; wheelchair access (Tabelog). Renamed from 日月餅 on 1 July 2011 (Tabelog). Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 2018–2020 and 2022; Wagashi WEST 100 2023 and 2026.
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-17-17, Shinmachi House 1F, south of Utsubo Park — 4 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn (Exit 2), 7 min from Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Mochi and wagashi from naturally farmed, pesticide-free rice, beans and sugar, mochi pounded daily (8 seats) · classics: black-bean mochi with Tanba black beans salt-boiled every morning, kusa mochi, raspberry daifuku coloured with beets, kuro mochi with hemp charcoal, monaka you fill yourself, chestnut daifuku, shigure, kurumi mochi with edamame or soybean paste · seasonal: chestnut chakin, Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc, fruit daifuku (Shine Muscat, peach, hozuki, strawberry), ginkgo daifuku, matcha soy-au-lait, "Gastronomic Herb" jelly with Kajitani Farm edible flowers, warabi mochi, mizu yokan · kakigori (September 2026) · tea room Kanro: reserved pairing course ¥6,600
places.notes: [Wagashi · Shinmachi, mochi from pesticide-free ingredients in a gallery-like shop] A wagashi maker that pounds its mochi daily in a sunken machine made more than 30 years ago and in use since the previous generation, and uses naturally farmed, pesticide-free glutinous rice, azuki, rice flour and sugar from contract growers across western Japan, testing each new harvest for radiation. The Shinmachi shop, renovated in 2026, looks like a concrete art gallery, with sweets laid out like jewels. The signature is the black-bean mochi, studded with big Tanba beans salt-boiled every morning around smooth bean paste; around it run a beet-red raspberry daifuku with white bean paste and rum, chestnut chakin and a pure-chestnut Mont Blanc in autumn, and fruit daifuku through the year. Behind a low crawl-through door the shop opened Kanro, a dim, quiet tea room serving a reserved four-course pairing of sweets and mochi dishes, a drink matched to each; an October 2026 guest had a crystal-like jelly with azuki tea, a hozuki daifuku, a mochi soup topped with crab and a chestnut kinton, then a Panama coffee cloth-dripped by the owner. Prices run high; popular items sell out, so go early. The owner, 石田, invites questions about the growers.

chef_bio.background: Wagashi maker with shops in Shinmachi (renamed from 日月餅 to Mochisho Shizuku on 1 July 2011, Tabelog), Kishiwada (where the workshop is) and Ashiya (『上』); the mochi machine has been used since the previous generation (shop website). The Shinmachi tea room ran for eighteen years before the January 2026 renovation (shop notice, 20 January 2026). The tea room Kanro opened in the renovated shop (shop notices, October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sweets as "the chief of a hundred medicines": naturally farmed, pesticide-free ingredients from contract growers, harvests tested for radiation each year; best mochi from "human plus machine" (shop website). Kanro is a "mountain retreat in the city", a designed quiet (shop notice, 15 October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-bean mochi with Tanba black beans; raspberry daifuku; seasonal chestnut sweets.

anecdotes.text: "The surface of the mochi is dotted with black beans, which are the finest quality from Tanba, Hyogo Prefecture, and are boiled in salt every morning at the shop." — October 2026, takeout.
"As I bent down to pass through a charming door in the corner, I was greeted by a dimly lit, minimalist space." — October 2026, the Kanro course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 餅匠しづく 新町店 (旧店名 日月餅、2011年7月1日に改名)、大阪市西区新町1-17-17 新町ハウス 1F、西大橋駅2番出口から徒歩4分、四ツ橋駅から徒歩7分、毎日10:30〜18:00、年中無休、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、8席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、車椅子可、食べログ スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018・2019・2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。店のサイト: 新町店・岸和田店 (工房)・芦屋『上』の3店、販売10:30〜18:00、茶寮13:00〜17:30、無休 (休みはお知らせ)、店主の石田、先代から使う埋め込み式の餅つき機、餅米・小豆・米粉・餅粉・砂糖・雑穀は自然農法・無農薬栽培、毎年1〜2月に放射能測定、黒豆餅 (毎朝丹波の黒豆を塩茹で)、草餅、フランボワーズ大福 (ビーツの赤)、黒餅 (麻炭)、最中、栗大福、しぐれ、くるみ餅、栗茶巾、ぎんなん大福、抹茶ソイオーレ (豆乳生クリーム)、2026年1月19日に十八年続いた茶寮を閉じて改装、改装中は milia burger の軒先で仮店舗、茶寮『甘露』は躙口のある予約制の茶寮、1日2席 (13時・15時)、甘味と餅料理とお茶のペアリングコース6600円、日本酒かノンアルコールの飲み物は別料金、中学生以上、アレルギーは予約時に。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 美術館のようなコンクリートの店内、宝石のような生菓子、栗大福、栗茶巾、和栗のモンブラン (生クリーム)、フランボワーズ大福、ほおずきの大福、シャインマスカットの大福、Gastronomic Herb (Kajitani Farm の食用花)、わらび餅、水羊羹、甘露のコースは結晶のようなゼリー状のお菓子と小豆茶、ほおずきの大福、蟹をのせた餅の椀、栗きんとん、店主がネルドリップで淹れるパナマのコーヒー、イートインは終わり、外に椅子が6脚ほど、値段は高め、売り切れもあるので早めに。

places.name: SPICE STAND TONGARI
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the shop pairs spice curry with a European-style curry, both on a dashi base, and the evening menu has fried dishes and pasta.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curries are made on dashi and built around beef, chicken, pork, venison and duck.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; Sun 11:00–15:00; closed Tuesday; some evenings closed irregularly (Tabelog). Lunch reservations only for the 11:00 opening; late arrivals may lose the seat to people waiting (Tabelog; an August 2026 diner arrived 2–3 minutes late and waited 30 minutes outside). Evening table charge ¥500, waived with a drink (Tabelog; June 2026 review). Order by QR code on your phone (2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; heated tobacco only, evenings only; children welcome, mini curry for kids; English menu (Tabelog). Opened 8 January 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-14-2, near the Orix Theater — 5 min from Hommachi Stn, 8 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn
places.cuisine: Spice curry counter by day, dining bar by night (7 seats) · two-curry plates: Tongari beef keema with sour chicken (yogurt-tart), beef keema with pork, coconut pork belly, venison keema with sour butter duck · spice taco rice · Tongari rice in sizes named after mountains, from Tenpozan to Everest · fresh vegetables, achar, nuts, fukujinzuke and rakkyo on the plate; spice level to order · evenings: spiced small plates, fried dishes, pasta, rice dishes, fried Tajima chicken · shochu, wine, cocktails
places.notes: [Curry · Shinmachi, a seven-seat spice-curry counter that turns dining bar at night] A small brick-walled counter with a natural-wood bar near the Orix Theater, run by one person, that opened in January 2025. Lunch is spice curry on a dashi base, usually two to a plate: the Tongari beef keema with its rich, spicy broth beside a yogurt-tart sour chicken, or rotating partners such as coconut pork belly, and lately game, with venison keema and a mild sour-butter duck. The plate comes heaped with fresh vegetables, achar, nuts and, unusually for spice curry, fukujinzuke and rakkyo. Rice sizes are named after mountains, from Osaka's tiny Tenpozan up to Everest. Order on your phone by QR code; a LINE sign-up gets a free pickled-egg topping. At night it becomes a dining bar with spiced snacks and fried Tajima chicken; a drink waives the ¥500 table charge. Lunch bookings are for 11:00 only, and the seat goes to the queue if you're late.

roles: Cook and owner (a one-person operation, per a March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Spice-curry counter and dining bar that opened on 8 January 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic spice curry from carefully chosen ingredients at lunch, spiced dishes with drinks at night (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Tongari beef keema; two-curry plates on a dashi base.

anecdotes.text: "You can choose the amount of rice, with the smallest portion named 'Tenpozan' and the largest 'Everest.'" — September 2026, venison keema and sour butter duck curry.
"It's interesting to see fukujinzuke (pickled vegetables) and rakkyo (pickled shallots) as toppings, which is rare for spice curry." — June 2026, beef keema and pork, ¥1,550.

Reservations accepted; no strong perfume; the shop may not be able to handle allergies (Tabelog). places.cuisine: French bistro and natural-wine bar, hearty cooking with organic vegetables from partner farms (20 seats) · dinner: tasting menu ¥7,700, prix fixe ¥5,500, wine pairing ¥4,400, plenty of à la carte and a bar menu (prosciutto, risotto) · lunch courses ¥2,100 to ¥4,400 · examples: Niçoise salad, marinated asparagus with poached egg, Mita pork simmered with white beans and Madeira sauce, US Prime outside-skirt steak frites, kombu-cured salmon, sous-vide pork tenderloin, Mita pork pâté en croûte, pan-seared yellowtail with tomato sauce, hamburg steak, chilled pumpkin soup, peach compote, cheesecake · house breads · natural wines by the glass
places.notes: [French · Shinmachi, a one-person bistro of big plates and natural wine] A casual French bistro beside the Orix Theater, open since 2018, that cooks hearty dishes from organic vegetables grown by partner farms and pours natural wine chosen by the sommelier and chef. One person runs both the room and the kitchen, so plan on a long, relaxed meal; diners call the service warm and the explanations careful. Portions are generous: a thick Mita pork pâté en croûte, Mita pork with white beans in Madeira sauce, skirt steak with fries, crisp-skinned yellowtail, with house breads one diner asked to have refilled. Dinner is a ¥7,700 tasting menu, a ¥5,500 prix fixe or à la carte; lunch courses run ¥2,100 to ¥4,400 and fill by noon on Saturdays, so book. Leave the strong perfume at home.

roles: Owner (runs the restaurant alone, per April and August 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: French bistro and wine bar that opened on 2 March 2018 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Hearty French cooking with organic vegetables from partner farms, paired with natural wines (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Mita pork dishes; pâté en croûte; natural-wine pairings.

places.cuisine: Salad bar and sandwich shop with vegetables direct from farmers and lettuce grown in-house by indoor, pesticide-free hydroponics (10 seats) · fill-a-cup salad bar, S ¥550 or L ¥880, as long as the lid closes, one bread included · bar items change daily: lettuce, tomatoes, broccoli, edamame, seaweed, kinpira, okara salad, sweet-potato salad, potato salad with shibazuke, carrot rapée, caponata, multigrain rice, oatmeal, pasta, salad chicken, roast ham, boiled eggs, crab-stick seafood salad · breads: rice-flour muffins and steamed breads (blueberry, mango, pumpkin, brown sugar, cheese), pound cake, garlic French bread · sandwiches and bento · cold-brew coffee, tea, juice; homemade sweets
places.notes: [Café · Hakurocho, a weekday fill-your-cup salad bar] A stylish, clean weekday salad shop between Sakaisuji-Hommachi and Nagahoribashi that grows its own lettuce hydroponically indoors and buys the rest of its vegetables straight from farmers. Grab a cup at the door and fill it from the self-serve bar for ¥550 (small) or ¥880 (large) — anything goes as long as the lid shuts, and one regular says the small one makes two meals. The spread changes daily: vegetables, okara and sweet-potato salads, kinpira, caponata, multigrain rice and pasta, with salad chicken, roast ham and boiled eggs for protein. A rice-flour muffin or steamed bread comes with it, and before 10:30 a drink is included. It is a vegetable shop, not a vegetarian one: meat, fish and eggs share the bar. Crowded from noon with office workers; Utsubo Park is a walk away for a picnic.

chef_bio.background: Salad and sandwich shop that opened on 11 October 2021 (Tabelog); vegetables bought direct from farmers and lettuce grown in-house (Tabelog, shop-provided; March 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh salads and filling sandwiches from farm-direct and home-grown vegetables; homemade sweets and drinks that bring out natural sweetness (Tabelog, shop-provided).

anecdotes.text: "Today's bread is gluten-free pumpkin bread made from rice flour, with a hint of sweetness and the essence of the ingredients." — August 2026, salad bar.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the signature is battered, deep-fried pork, and the menu runs on wheat noodles, gyoza and soy-seasoned stir-fries.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, chicken, liver, shrimp, crab and egg run through the menu.

No reservations (Tabelog); the 10 seats fill soon after 17:00, so arrive at opening or wait outside (September–October 2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; takeout available (Tabelog; October 2026 review).

places.cuisine: Local Chinese (machi-chuka) counter, 10 seats, one cook · pork kara-age ("Tonkara"), a whole thick cut of loin or chuck eye roll, with mustard-vinegar soy sauce or pink salt, ¥950 (August 2026) · stir-fries: pork and egg ¥950, chicken and green pepper ¥700 (September 2026), liver and garlic chives, pork and garlic chives, shrimp with egg · fried rice ¥500, five-ingredient fried rice ¥700 (September 2026), crab fried rice with real crab · Tianjin rice with salt or soy sauce · off-menu omurice · gyoza ¥300 (August 2026) · steamed chicken · century egg · sweet and sour pork · yakisoba · fried rice vermicelli · champon · ramen ¥500 with chashu (July 2026), shio ramen, miso ramen · cold noodles ¥900 (August 2026) · bottled Kirin Lager or Asahi Super Dry ¥600, draft beer, sake, shochu
places.notes: [Local Chinese · Shinsekai, a one-person Showa counter under Tsutenkaku] A narrow ten-seat counter behind red lanterns and a red noren, a few steps from Tsutenkaku, open only in the evening and run by a single cook who works the kitchen at the back. The owner told one diner the shop has been here about 60 years, passed down from the previous generation, and that the name is not about Hong Kong at all: it is short for 'Kagawa's port', after Kagawa roots. Nearly everyone orders the Tonkara, a whole thick cut of pork (loin or chuck eye roll, both shown to you before you choose) fried crisp and juicy, so big that one diner took the rest home; it comes with mustard-vinegar soy sauce, and half portions are refused because a smaller piece would not taste right. Around it: oily, salty stir-fries made for bottled beer, moist fried rice, an off-menu omurice, a light shio ramen for ¥500. The seats fill within minutes of the 17:00 opening, orders wait their turn because one person cooks everything, and one diner had doubts about cleanliness; another calls it the epitome of local Chinese food.

roles: Owner (runs the shop alone, per July and September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Local Chinese restaurant of about 60 years, "passed down from the previous generation," per the owner (September 2026 review). The name is short for "Kagawa's port": one diner heard the owner's roots are in Kagawa (September 2026), another that the previous owner came from Kagawa (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: No half portions of the pork kara-age, as a smaller piece would not bring out its true flavor (May 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "According to the owner, it has been around for about 60 years, passed down from the previous generation. The name 'Hong Kong' comes from the owner's roots in Kagawa, which means 'Kagawa's port' in a shortened form." — September 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the tantanmen, mazesoba and dim sum use wheat, and the kakigori syrups and espuma are not described for gluten.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit and tea kakigori and a soy-milk tantanmen are on the menu, but the espuma is yogurt or almond, milk syrups and milk teas are common, and nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–20:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Kakigori from 12:00 (August 2026 review). No reservations (Tabelog); kakigori can take 15 minutes or more to arrive in summer (July–August 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: 15 at tables, 5 at the counter; sofa seating; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout (Tabelog). Opened 15 June 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Utsubo-honmachi 2-2-23, near Utsubo Park — 6 min from Awaza Stn (Exit 1), 8 min from Hommachi Stn (Exit 18)
places.cuisine: Taiwanese-style cafe for kakigori, tapioca and a light Chinese lunch (20 seats) · fluffy kakigori topped with almond or yogurt espuma: strawberry milk ¥1,760 (August 2026), mango tea ¥1,500 (May 2026), jasmine tea ¥1,265 (December 2025), white chocolate, "Red & White & Black" chocolate, white peach, black sugar douhua; extra toppings such as tapioca and mango · tapioca milk teas, the No. 1 being black sugar pu-erh milk tea ¥660 (August 2026), sweetness and ice to order · soy milk tantanmen ¥990, rice ¥220 (March 2026) · Taiwanese mazesoba with fish powder and egg yolk · water dumplings ¥800, coconut balls ¥500 (May 2026) · dim sum set of 8 pieces ¥1,000 (September 2026), xiaolongbao · coffee, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Kakigori and tantanmen · Utsubo-honmachi, a Taiwanese-style cafe by Utsubo Park] A calm cafe near Utsubo Park that one diner calls a Taiwanese restaurant, where most diners come for one of two things: kakigori or the tantanmen. The ice is fluffy but holds its shape, comes generous and photogenic, and is topped with your choice of almond or yogurt espuma — the almond one diner found 'shockingly good'; flavors run from strawberry milk and white chocolate to jasmine tea and black sugar douhua. Kakigori starts at noon and can take a while in summer. The tapioca drinks are huge and cheap for the area, with half-price takeout during time sales. At lunch the creamy soy-milk tantanmen is gentle rather than fiery; add rice if you must, though two diners thought it not worth the ¥220.

chef_bio.background: Cafe that opened on 15 June 2012 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kakigori with espuma; tapioca milk tea; soy-milk tantanmen.

anecdotes.text: "The almond mousse was shockingly good, delivering an explosion of flavor the moment it touched my palate." — August 2026, strawberry milk kakigori ¥1,760.

"The smoothness of the soy milk combined perfectly with the characteristic spiciness of tantanmen, creating a well-balanced dish that had depth while still being gentle on the palate." — March 2026, soy milk tantanmen ¥990.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: one dish of noodles dipped in a soy-based men-tsuyu; the udon and Chinese noodles are wheat, and the soba blend is not stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dipping sauce is full of duck, dried small fish and quail egg.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 (last order 15:00); closed Thursday; may close early when ingredients run out (Tabelog; official shop list). Ticket machine at the door; one main order per person; no children under 10 (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No phone (official shop list). 10 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). The head shop of the Kamo Kin group, opened December 2005 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Ebisu-higashi 2-9-8, Friendly Naniwa 1F, near Tsutenkaku — 5 min from Ebisucho, Dobutsuen-mae and JR Shin-Imamiya Stns
places.cuisine: Tsuke kamo udon: one dish, noodles dipped in a hot duck sauce (10-seat counter) · the sauce is packed with thinly sliced duck, dried small fish (iriko), quail egg, lemon slices and green onion · choose udon (thin or thick), soba or Chinese noodles, half-and-half possible, served cold or hot, in one, two or three servings; small ¥900 (August–October 2026) · soba comes with mizuna, lotus root, carrot and spinach (July 2026) · rice balls (salmon, kombu or ume), salmon ¥150 (October 2026) · finish by thinning the sauce with ginger hot water from a tokkuri · table spices: ichimi, shichimi, black shichimi, black pepper, curry powder
places.notes: [Udon · Shinsekai, the 2005 head shop of a duck dipping-noodle brand] A ten-seat counter a few minutes from Tsutenkaku that serves one thing: a hot dipping sauce crowded with thin slices of duck, tiny dried fish, quail egg, lemon and green onion, and your choice of udon, soba or Chinese noodles in one, two or three servings (regulars go for three, one diner says). The duck fat makes it rich and the lemon keeps it bright. When the noodles are gone, pour the ginger hot water from the tokkuri into what is left and drink it down. The founding story on the official site: at 48, with ¥2 million in hand, the founder recalled a tsuke kamo udon shop loved in leaner days and long gone, spent six months on a men-tsuyu to beat it, and opened on a main street; five of the six first-day customers came back the next day. This counter, opened in December 2005, became the head shop. One long-time diner noticed new staff, a slightly changed name and higher prices in 2026, but the same taste. Lunch only, cash only, and it can sell out early.

chef_bio.background: Founded by a married couple, 太山信泰 and 香奈子 (official site, company page). Opened in December 2005 as the group's second directly run shop and its head shop; the brand then grew by franchise (32 franchise openings by 2021) and was transferred in February 2021 to 株式会社アシスト of Kishiwada, which lists seven shops today (official site, read 2026-10-30). One diner noticed unfamiliar staff and a slightly changed name in September 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: One dish: a duck dipping sauce whose men-tsuyu stands up to the duck fat and flavor, finished with ginger hot water (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The base consists of thinly sliced duck, iriko (dried sardines), and lemon slices in the broth… This time, we opted for one serving of Chinese noodles, but regulars usually go for three servings." — August 2026.
"Once you finish the noodles, the Kamo Kin way is to dilute the remaining sauce with ginger tea served in a tokkuri… to enjoy until the last drop." — October 2026, small soba ¥900.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: つけ鴨うどん 鴨錦 恵美須店、大阪市浪速区恵美須東2-9-8 フレンドリー浪速 1F、動物園前駅・恵美須町駅・JR新今宮駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金〜日11:00〜15:00、木曜休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、10席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、1人1品、10歳未満の子供は遠慮、公式サイトあり。公式サイト: 大阪新世界発祥のつけ鴨うどん、恵美須店(本店)、電話なし、11時〜15時 (L.O.15時)、鴨肉とネギ、レモン、じゃこなどが入ったつけ汁、濃厚なのに後味さっぱり、食べ終わったら生姜湯を入れて好みの濃さに、創業者 太山信泰・香奈子夫妻、当時48歳で手元の200万円から昔通ったつけ鴨うどんの味を超えるめんつゆを半年かけて開発、初日の客6名のうち5名が翌日も来店、たっぷり80gの鴨肉、一玉220g、2005年12月に直営2号店「恵美須本店」、FC32号店まで、2021年2月に株式会社アシスト (岸和田市) が事業譲受、店舗一覧は7店、FC加盟店募集。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 薄切りの鴨、いりこ、うずらの卵、レモン、ネギ、うどん (細麺・太麺)、そば、中華麺から選べる、半々も、量は1玉・2玉・3玉、小900円、そばに水菜・れんこん・にんじん・ほうれん草、おにぎり (鮭・昆布・梅) 鮭150円、徳利の生姜湯、一味・七味・黒七味・黒胡椒・カレー粉、券売機、店名が少し変わりスタッフも替わったが味は昔のまま。

places.name: 瓦町仔鹿 (Kawara Machi Bambi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dumplings, shumai, battered and fried dishes, noodles and soy- and oyster-sauce stir-fries make up the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the stocks are made in-house and the menu is built on pork, chicken, beef, horse, shrimp and crab.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday; evenings only; closing time may vary and dishes can sell out, so call ahead (Tabelog). The official site gives 18:00–22:30 last order. Reservations accepted; cancel by phone on the day; 2-hour limit at busy times (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 19 seats: 7 at the counter, three tables of 4; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 13 October 2015 (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi 1-4-6, Ichioka Kosan Bldg B1F — 3 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn (Exit 12), 6 min from Kitahama Stn (Exit 5)
places.cuisine: Creative Chinese in a basement (19 seats) · official menu (undated): steamed chicken ¥770, zha cai ¥550, century egg ¥550, house char siu ¥850, pork belly cold dish ¥850 · pan-fried gyoza ¥500, meat shumai wrapped in yuba (4) ¥880, scallop shumai (3) ¥880 · fried chicken BAMBI-style ¥800, yurinchi ¥900, crab-claw croquettes of Hokkaido scallop, white fish and shrimp ¥880 · black-vinegar sweet and sour pork ¥980, spicy mapo tofu and white mapo tofu ¥1,200 each, shrimp chili ¥1,000, big shrimp with mayonnaise ¥1,680 · spicy tantanmen ¥1,100, green fried rice (spinach) ¥950, crab fried rice ¥2,000, crispy noodles with seafood sauce ¥1,580 · ma lai gao, sesame balls, almond tofu · blackboard specials (2025–2026): horse-meat carpaccio, cold stir-fried pork or beef with green peppers (summer), jellyfish, crab potato salad, sweet-miso beef in lettuce, xiaolongbao · Shaoxing wine by the glass or aged bottles, Sichuan-pepper and Shaoxing highballs with bear- or rose-shaped ice, wine
places.notes: [Chinese · Kawaramachi near Kitahama, a former head chef's basement with white mapo tofu] Down a staircase into a building's basement, a hideout Chinese restaurant opened in 2015 by 河野幸成, once executive chef of a high-end Chinese restaurant. The aim is Chinese food that isn't heavy: the stocks, chili oil and sauces are all blended in-house. Its calling card is the white mapo tofu, milder than the red one (also on the menu) and best ordered, one diner insists, with the bright green spinach fried rice; diners add the yuba-wrapped shumai, the steamed chicken with chili oil, and whatever is on the blackboard — horse-meat carpaccio, cold summer stir-fries with green peppers, jellyfish, crab potato salad. One diner sees a French touch in the plating, the highballs come with bear- or rose-shaped ice, and diners describe a kind manager to chat with at the counter.

chef_bio.background: Former executive chef (総料理長) of a high-end Chinese restaurant (official site); the Tabelog shop text gives 13 years as head chef at a renowned Chinese restaurant. Opened Kawara Machi Bambi in a basement in Chuo-ku in October 2015 (official site; Tabelog opening date 13 October 2015).
chef_bio.philosophy: Chinese food that does not feel heavy: care over ingredients, cooking and seasoning; stocks, chili oil and sauces all blended in-house; seasonal dishes that use the ingredients well (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: White mapo tofu; green fried rice; yuba-wrapped shumai.

anecdotes.text: "The combination of White Mapo Tofu and Green Fried Rice brings pure bliss to your palate. This is definitely a set you should order together." — March 2026.

"The almond tofu was made with brown sugar and Shaoxing wine, and I was told there were strawberries available that day… The dishes on the blackboard menu here are truly delicious and never disappoint." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 瓦町仔鹿、大阪市中央区瓦町1-4-6 市岡宏産ビル B1F、堺筋本町駅12番出口から徒歩3分、北浜駅5番出口から徒歩6分、月〜土・祝18:00〜22:00、日曜休み、夜のみ、売り切れ次第終了、予約可 (混雑時2時間制)、カード (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners)・QR可、電子マネー不可、19席 (カウンター7、テーブル4×3)、貸切は20名まで、禁煙、子供可、オープン日2015年10月13日。公式サイト: 2015年10月にビルの地下でオープンした瓦町仔鹿 (カワラマチバンビ)、高級中華レストランで総料理長を務めた河野幸成の独創的な中華料理、重くない中華、ダシも辣油もソースもすべて独自にブレンド、季節のメニュー、18:00〜22:30 L.O、日曜休み。メニュー: 蒸し鶏770円、ザーサイ550円、ピータン550円、自家製焼豚850円、雲白肉850円、焼餃子500円、湯葉をまとった肉焼売880円、貝柱入り肉焼売880円、鶏モモ肉の唐揚げ～BAMBI流～800円、油淋鶏900円、カニ爪揚げ880円、黒酢の酢豚980円、辛麻婆豆腐1200円、白い麻婆豆腐1200円、海老のチリソース1000円、大海老のマヨネーズソース1680円、揚げそばの海鮮あんかけ1580円、辛担担麺1100円、炒飯(グリーン)950円、蟹肉入り炒飯2000円、マーラーカオ、胡麻団子、なめらか杏仁豆腐、紹興酒。口コミ(2025年5月〜2026年8月): 白い麻婆豆腐とグリーンの炒飯、黒板のメニュー、馬肉のカルパッチョ、夏の冷たいピーマン炒め、くらげ、カニのポテトサラダ、甘味噌の牛肉のレタス包み、黒糖と紹興酒の杏仁豆腐、小籠包、山椒ハイボール、熊やバラの形の氷、フレンチのような盛りつけ、気さくな店長。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead in the evening; menu on the official site (2026).
