places.name: 焼肉 福家 (Yakiniku Fukuya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: no gluten information; sauces and marinades are not described. The salted tongue is seasoned with sesame oil and a house salt-and-pepper blend (Tabelog menu) — ask about the seasoning. Cold noodles, bibimbap and gukbap round out the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef and offal yakiniku house. Seasonal local grilled vegetables, salads and namul are on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan — ask.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed Thursday; open straight through 28 December–4 January (Tabelog, shop-maintained listing). Savor Japan (USEN) instead lists Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00, closed Monday — call to check. Reservations accepted; phone 06-6211-2667 (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). 15 seats: 6 at the counter and two tables of 4; whole-shop booking for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; a May 2023 diner: the whole restaurant allows smoking). Average ¥8,000–9,999 a head (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-3-1, the quieter east end of Dotonbori — 4 min from Kintetsu Nippombashi Stn, 7 min from Namba
places.cuisine: Small yakiniku and offal house, Imari beef and black wagyu · noodle appetizer on arrival (warm in March 2025, cold in May 2026) · specialty salted tongue, thin slices grilled quickly and wrapped round green onion and lemon ¥1,980 (premium) / ¥1,100 (regular) · outside skirt from ¥1,210, special premium ¥3,180, served last · premium mino tripe ¥1,100, special ¥1,430 · wagyu tetchan (small intestine) ¥990 · heart, honeycomb tripe, omasum, red omasum and other wagyu offal ¥880 each · yukhoe · red-meat cuts ¥2,750 · tenderloin ¥3,300 · chateaubriand ¥7,480 · seasonal local grilled vegetables ¥440 · kimchi ¥550 · cold noodles ¥990 · stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,100 · chuhai with whole seasonal fruit · sake (menu prices from the Tabelog menu page, last updated March 2021)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Dotonbori, a 15-seat offal and salted-tongue house] A small yakiniku counter at the quiet east end of Dotonbori, with six counter seats and two tables, known for Imari beef and fresh wagyu offal. Dinner opens with a bowl of noodles as an appetizer, and the staff grill the first piece; several diners started with the specialty salted tongue: thin slices seared quickly and wrapped round a heap of green onion with lemon. The owner steers the order, recommending rare cuts and the tripe, and the outside skirt comes last, after which no more meat is served (a December 2024 diner). Diners praise the honeycomb tripe, mino, tetchan, yukhoe and thick-cut tongue, and the staff's grilling; a 2023 diner found the lean cuts average next to the offal. Expect about ¥8,000–10,000 a head. Diners call the owner friendly and entertaining, and the shop has been on TV and is said to be a favourite of Yoshimoto comedians. Smoking is allowed; book ahead. Closed Thursday on Tabelog (Monday on Savor Japan).

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing headed "Dotonbori Premium Salted beef tongue". A beloved local yakiniku restaurant serving Imari beef (September 2024 review); "All the meat is made from Imari beef" (October 2025 review). Savor Japan photo captions: 「伊万里牛をはじめとした厳選の黒毛和牛」, 「希少な黒毛和牛100％のタン『名物塩タン』」, 「日本酒ソムリエが選ぶ、肉に合う季節の日本酒」. The owner and two staff members taught a family to grill (October 2024 review). An October 2025 diner came after seeing it on TV; a May 2023 diner heard it is popular with Yoshimoto comedians. Onions and green onions from Osaka (November 2022 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Each piece of meat carefully selected, and the owner talks passionately about quality (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Salted tongue wrapped round green onion; outside skirt as the last dish; wagyu offal.

anecdotes.text: "I've been told that the outside skirt (harami) is served last, and once it comes out, they won't serve any more meat. However, once I tasted it, I understood why." — December 2024.

"I ordered my favorites, tongue and outside skirt, but the chef advised me to eat the outside skirt first, as it would leave me wanting more after trying other dishes. So, I changed my order to start with the fresh omasum" — September 2025.
"The cold noodles served as an appetizer were delicious! … Above all, the owner was kind, friendly, and a wonderful person!" — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 福家 (フクヤ)、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-3-1、近鉄日本橋駅から徒歩4分、なんば駅から徒歩7分、月〜水・金〜日17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、木曜定休、12月28日〜1月4日も休まず営業、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QRコード決済不可、15席 (カウンター6席、4人がけテーブル2卓)、貸切は20人まで、喫煙可、平均8000〜9999円。食べログのメニュー (2021年3月更新): 名物の塩タン、薄切りのタンをさっと焼いてねぎとレモンを巻く 1980円 (上)・1100円、ハラミ1210円から、特上は3180円で最後に、ミノ1100円・特上1430円、黒毛和牛のテッチャン990円、ハツやハチノスなどの和牛ホルモン各880円、赤身2750円、ヒレ3300円、シャトーブリアン7480円、季節の地野菜の焼き野菜440円、キムチ550円、冷麺990円、石焼ビビンバ1100円、季節の果物まるごとのチューハイ。Savor Japan (USEN): 焼肉福家、火〜日・祝 17:00〜24:00、月曜定休、カード可、喫煙可、カウンター席、写真の説明に「伊万里牛をはじめとした厳選の黒毛和牛」「名物塩タン」「特選ハラミ」「特上ミノ」「テッチャン」「日本酒ソムリエが選ぶ、肉に合う季節の日本酒」。口コミ (2022年8月〜2026年8月): 伊万里牛、最初に麺の前菜 (温かい麺、冷麺)、最初の一枚やタンは店員が焼いてくれる、ハラミが出たら最後、店主のおすすめで希少部位、ハチノスやミノがおいしい、ユッケ、赤身は普通という声も、店主が気さくで楽しい、テレビで見て来たという人、吉本の芸人に人気という話、全席喫煙、誕生日に小さなアイスケーキ、大阪産の玉ねぎやねぎ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter shop; staff grill the first piece and explain how to grill the rest (2024–2026 reviews). Smoking allowed.

places.name: 宇治香園 大阪心斎橋店 (Uji Koen)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The soft serve comes in a cone and the tea room has served a roll cake; among the teas the shop sells is barley tea (mugicha), which is not gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The matcha soft serve, matcha latte and roll cake are not described, so assume dairy or egg unless told otherwise; brewed teas are served in the tea room, but nothing on how they are served (milk, sweets) is stated.
places.hours_raw: Shop daily 12:00–19:00; takeout (soft serve and drinks) 12:00–18:30; tea room Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays only, 14:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed over the New Year holidays (shop site and Tabelog). The shop site says the tea room was closed for renovation until 31 October 2026 and reopens on 1 November, with different hours on some November days (check the shop calendar). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC cards, WAON, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Alipay, WeChat Pay, Merpay (Tabelog). 5 counter seats in the tea room; non-smoking (Tabelog); a bench for two by the takeout counter (December 2023 review).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 1-5-19, on the Shinsaibashi-suji shopping arcade — from Shinsaibashi Station (Midosuji Line) Exit 6, 3 min along the arcade towards Namba
places.cuisine: Japanese tea shop with a tea room at the back (5 seats) · takeout: rich matcha soft serve dusted with matcha powder (¥500 in August 2025, ¥400 in December 2023), a matcha-and-milk mix, matcha latte · tea room (Fri–Sun and holidays): gyokuro brewed at the seat with an hourglass timer and refills, hojicha, matcha ice cream, hojicha roll cake (reviews 2023–2025) · leaf tea, tea bags and gift boxes to take home: matcha, sencha, gyokuro, hojicha, genmaicha, Japanese black tea
places.notes: [Cafe · Shinsaibashi-suji, an 80-year-old tea shop with a hidden tea room] The Osaka shop of Uji Koen, a Kyoto tea maker founded in 1865, which opened on Shinsaibashi-suji in 1946, just after the war, and is today the company's only shop besides its head office and factory in Kyoto. Most people stop at the front for the rich matcha soft serve — deep green, slightly bitter, heaped with matcha powder that one diner warns will leave a green ring round your lips. Behind the noren is a quiet five-seat counter (Friday to Sunday and holidays, 14:00–17:00) where tea is brewed at your seat: one diner brewed gyokuro with lukewarm water and an hourglass timer, took refills and shared a hojicha roll cake. Two reviewers only learned later that it was there. The shelves hold matcha, sencha, gyokuro and hojicha in the white packaging that won an iF Design Award (2021) and a Good Design Award (2025).

chef_bio.background: Uji Koen (株式会社 宇治香園) began as a tea peddler in Yamashiro, Kyoto, in 1865, exported tea to the United States through Kobe from about 1878, and opened the Shinsaibashi shop in 1946; the shop added its Japanese-tea tea room in 2003. The company marked its 160th year in 2025 (shop site, history page). Its company page lists only the Kyoto head office and factory and this Osaka Shinsaibashi shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: A Japanese tea specialist that first-timers can drop into, helping customers choose tea for every day or as a gift; tea brewed in a kyusu in a quiet room away from the bustle of Shinsaibashi-suji (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Rich matcha soft serve; gyokuro and hojicha in the tea room.

anecdotes.text: "Although it faces Shinsaibashi, I didn't realize there was an eat-in area in the back, making it a hidden gem." — March 2025, second visit; the tea room had to be opened on request just after 14:00.
"I poured lukewarm water over it and used the hourglass timer. It was incredibly sweet and fragrant gyokuro." — November 2023, gyokuro and a hojicha roll cake in the tea room.
"While it tastes great, be careful as the powder tends to stick around your mouth. I ended up walking around Namba all day with green around my lips." — October 2025, matcha soft serve.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト: 宇治香園 大阪心斎橋店、昭和21年に心斎橋筋に日本茶専門店を構え、店の奥に喫茶、店舗12:00〜19:00、テイクアウト12:00〜18:30、喫茶は金・土・日・祝のみ14:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、休みは年末年始、喫茶は改修工事で10月31日まで休業し11月1日から再開、急須で淹れる日本茶の喫茶、テイクアウトのドリンクや抹茶ソフトクリーム、お茶の淹れ方教室「いちわん茶会」は休止中。会社情報: 株式会社 宇治香園、創業は慶應元年 (1865年)、京都本社・工場と大阪心斎橋店。あゆみ: 京都山城で茶の行商から始まり、明治11年ごろからアメリカ向けに輸出、昭和21年に大阪心斎橋店、平成15年に日本茶専門の喫茶、令和3年に iF デザインアワード、令和7年に創業百六十年とグッドデザイン賞。食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-5-19、心斎橋駅6番出口から心斎橋筋をなんば方面に徒歩3分、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、カウンター5席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年10月〜2025年10月): 抹茶パウダーをたっぷりかけた濃い抹茶ソフト (2023年12月400円、2025年8月500円)、抹茶とミルクのミックス、抹茶ラテ、奥の喫茶で砂時計を使って淹れる玉露とおかわり、ほうじ茶、ほうじ茶のロールケーキ、抹茶アイス、ほうじ茶と玉露のティーバッグ、店頭にベンチ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order soft serve at the front counter; tea room only Fri–Sun and holidays, 14:00–17:00.

places.name: すし居酒屋 しんご (Sushi Izakaya Shingo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; sushi with soy sauce, a sweet soy sauce on some dishes, and fried dishes (mentaiko tempura, fried chicken, fried octopus) on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, seafood and wagyu dishes, and chawanmushi.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:30 (last order: food 23:00, drinks 23:15); closed Sunday; closing time may move with stock (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog), also by Instagram DM to @sushi_shingo (2022 review); the one table is hard to get (April 2026 review) and a Friday in September 2025 was fully booked. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for 8; private hire possible; smoking allowed (Tabelog). The owner usually works alone, so food can take a while when full (2024–2025 reviews). Opened 22 June 2021 (a regular's June 2022 review marks the first anniversary that day).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-4-19, Tamayacho Galaxy Bldg No. 3, ground floor, at the entrance; small sign — 4 min (300 m) from Nagahoribashi Stn Exit 7
places.cuisine: Sushi izakaya (16 seats): nigiri and small rolls alongside izakaya dishes · examples with prices (December 2023): seafood bukkake sushi (a bite-size roll piled with chopped salmon, yellowtail, sea bream and tobiko) ¥1,280, shirako ponzu ¥900, wagyu yukhoe ¥1,380, raw shrimp ¥350, draft beer ¥550 · Japanese-style potato salad with tobiko and smoked daikon · mentaiko tempura · drinkable chawanmushi · wagyu sukiyaki roll dipped in egg · seafood yukhoe · nigiri such as butter eel, anago, seared scallop, tuna with uni, seared wagyu, toro-taku · an 8-dish course (sashimi platter, butter-soy scallops, grilled yellowtail collar, seared beef sushi with uni and ikura, nigiri, hosomaki, chawanmushi; September 2025) · winter "gout hot pot" of oysters, shirako and monkfish liver in yuzu miso, by reservation (February 2024) · sake
places.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a one-person counter with a fiercely loyal following] A small sushi izakaya with a small sign on the ground floor of a Galaxy building in the Higashi-Shinsaibashi back streets, opened in June 2021. Despite the name, the owner is Koji, not Shingo — a regular who has been more than 50 times had to learn that too. Koji is young, quiet ('a samurai vibe', April 2026), may seem unfriendly at first and turns out to be very kind, and usually cooks, makes the sushi and serves alone, so a full house means waits. The menu changes often: seafood bukkake sushi under a heap of chopped fish and tobiko, potato salad with tobiko and smoked daikon, mentaiko tempura, a wagyu sukiyaki roll dipped in egg, and in winter a reserved hot pot of oysters, shirako and monkfish liver that diners call the 'gout hot pot'. Book the one table early: on one Friday in September 2025 the place was full and many walk-ins were turned away.

chef_bio.background: Opened Sushi Izakaya Shingo on 22 June 2021 (first-anniversary review, June 2022). "Just to clarify, the owner is not Shingo-san, but Koji-san." (June 2022 review). Reviewers describe a young chef who runs the shop single-handed (August 2025; also October 2024, December 2024, February 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi with izakaya dishes; seafood bukkake sushi; potato salad with tobiko.

anecdotes.text: "I laughed when I first called Koji-san Shingo-san. Just to clarify, the owner is not Shingo-san, but Koji-san." — June 2022, on the first anniversary.
"The head chef has a quiet demeanor that gives off a samurai vibe, which might be appealing!" — April 2026, omakase course at a business dinner.

"The Seafood Bukkake Sushi was delightful. On top of a bite-sized sushi roll, there was a generous amount of chopped salmon, yellowtail, sea bream, and other seafood, all topped with a large serving of tobiko." — December 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): すし居酒屋 しんご、居酒屋・寿司・海鮮、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-19 玉屋町ギャラクシービル3号館 1F、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩4分 (300m)、月〜土・祝17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 料理23:00、ドリンク23:15)、日曜休み、在庫で閉店時間が変わることも、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、16席 (カウンター8、8人のテーブル1)、貸切可、喫煙可、魚と日本酒にこだわり。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年4月): 2021年6月22日オープン、店主は Koji さん (しんごさんではない)、インスタ @sushi_shingo のDMで予約、若い大将がひとりで切り盛り、最初は無愛想に見えるがいい人、侍のような静かな大将、看板が小さく見つけにくい、海鮮ぶっかけ寿司1280円、白子ポン酢900円、wagyu のユッケ1380円、生えび350円、生ビール550円 (2023年12月)、とびこと燻製の大根の入ったポテトサラダ、明太子の天ぷら、飲めるような茶碗蒸し、wagyu のすき焼き巻き、海鮮ユッケ、うなぎのバター焼き、穴子、ほたての炙り、うに乗せのまぐろ、トロたく、8品のコース (2025年9月)、冬は予約制の牡蠣・白子・あん肝の柚子味噌の鍋 (gout hot pot)、2025年9月の金曜は満席で断られる人も、テーブルは1つだけ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead, especially for the one table; one person cooks and serves, so expect waits; smoking allowed.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; an omakase of sushi with soy sauce (the horse-meat nigiri comes with a slightly sweet soy sauce), red miso soup, simmered dishes and low-temperature-fried ayu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase course of fish, shellfish and horse meat, with chawanmushi and tamago.
places.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–2:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call to change or cancel; tell the shop ahead if bringing children (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 5 October 2022 (Tabelog). Omakase course ¥22,000 (August 2026 reviews), about two hours; à la carte also available (August 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-5-31, 月虎51番館 3F — 5 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Stn (Sakaisuji Line) or Shinsaibashi Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Omakase sushi counter (7 seats) built on seafood from the chef's home prefecture, Kumamoto, and Amakusa · omakase ¥22,000 (August 2026): small dishes, sashimi, a seasonal simmered dish, a grilled dish, 6–8 nigiri, rolls, chawanmushi, soup and dessert · examples (2024–2026): chilled chawanmushi with king crab or Kumamoto red eggplant, ayu confit, monkfish liver with Nara-zuke, three kinds of gari (napa cabbage, lotus root, ginger), Amakusa sea bream, marinated tuna, toro (including three-year-aged toro), kohada, aori squid with sea urchin, kuruma shrimp, horse-meat nigiri with a slightly sweet soy sauce, simmered anago, red miso soup, a pudding-like tamago · sake chosen by the chef, who holds a sake diploma
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a late-night Kumamoto omakase counter] A seven-seat hinoki counter on the third floor of a Higashi-Shinsaibashi building, calm and Japanese in a way the outside gives no hint of, open from 18:00 to 2:00 — one diner sneaked out after putting the kids to bed. The chef, from Kumamoto, builds the ¥22,000 omakase on fish from Kumamoto and Amakusa: chilled chawanmushi, ayu confit, monkfish liver with Nara-zuke, three kinds of house gari, then nigiri from Amakusa sea bream to aori squid crowned with sea urchin. The signature is horse-meat nigiri from Kumamoto with a slightly sweet soy sauce, which brought one reviewer to tears. The chef holds a sake diploma and pairs sake with the courses; one August 2026 review says the chef trained at a Michelin three-star restaurant. In June 2024 the chef was working solo and still kept a good pace.

From Kumamoto; craftsmanship "honed through traditional Japanese cuisine" (July 2026 review); one August 2026 review: "Run by a chef from a Michelin three-star restaurant" (the restaurant is not named). Holds a sake diploma (July and August 2026 reviews). Working solo at a June 2024 visit.
chef_bio.philosophy: Omakase built on seasonal fish and other ingredients from Kumamoto and Amakusa(Tabelog headline; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Horse-meat nigiri; three kinds of gari; monkfish liver with Nara-zuke.

anecdotes.text: "The chef, hailing from Kumamoto, confidently serves this horse meat sushi. With each bite, the umami and sweetness overflowed, making it an exquisite piece." — August 2026, omakase, second visit.
"I tried the three-year-aged toro (fatty tuna) for the first time, and it was exciting. However, I think it might be a matter of personal preference." — August 2026.
"The chef was friendly, creating a relaxed atmosphere at the counter, making it easy to enjoy the meal without feeling too tense." — August 2026, omakase.
